question: Find every code path that deletes or hides a quickDictationDrafts box (unassigned or assigned): a cron (convex/crons.ts), a lifecycle sweep (convex/lib/lifecycle.ts and its callers), a client purge, a TTL, or an explicit user action. For each, which clock does it use (server time or the device clock) and which window? Is there any retention window for boxes at all, and if so what is its value?

rule.pass: no box is removed silently: a box goes only by an explicit user action, or by a rule on the server clock (never the device clock)
rule.fail: a box is dropped silently (no user action removes it, yet it goes), or the rule that clears boxes uses the device clock, not the server clock
basis: never silently before it, and the same on every device clock

halves.Q6 window: pending Q6 (Daniela): not run in this lane
halves.ageing run: TIME (T+11..37 h on a moved server clock): not run in this lane

answers.answer:
At e02167f, Quick Dictation boxes have no retention window at all: no 12, 18 or 36 h, no TTL and no timed clean-up. The only cron (apps/web/convex/crons.ts) is the hourly expired-session sweep, and convex/lib/lifecycle.ts never mentions quickDictationDrafts. A box can be deleted in only three ways, and each one is a person's action carried out on the server:
(1) quickDictation.remove, called only from deleteCompartment when the physician taps delete in the Quick Dictation modal or on the sheet;
(2) quickDictation.clear, which the client wires up in data/rounding.ts but never calls;
(3) account deletion (account.ts), which removes boxes with via "account_deleted".
Every delete writes an audit row. Assigning a box marks it and never deletes it. The pad lists every box the user owns, sorted by order, with no time filter, so the device clock never removes or hides a box from the pad.
One device-clock rule exists, but it is outside the pad: the Rounding Sheet (hidden, Q14) shows an assigned box under its patient only if assignedAt falls on today's date by the device clock (compartmentsPlacedToday / isToday). The box itself stays on the pad.
So the code-decidable rule passes: nothing drops a box silently. Whether boxes should clear at a set window is left to Q6, which the oracle says does not decide this verdict. Today the code would keep both boxes past T+37 h on any clock.

At commit e02167f, Quick Dictation boxes have no time limit, so nothing removes them silently. Code can delete a box in three ways:
1. `quickDictation.remove`, run when the physician taps delete on a box (`deleteCompartment`).
2. `quickDictation.clear`. It is exposed in `data/rounding.ts`, but no screen calls it.
3. Account deletion (`account.ts`, via "account_deleted").

All three are server mutations started by the user, and each writes an audit row. The only cron (`crons.ts`) sweeps expired sessions. `lib/lifecycle.ts` never touches drafts. The pad hook and modal show every row from `quickDictation.list`, with no filter on age or clock. Assigning a box marks it (`assignedAt` = `Date.now()` on the server) and never deletes it.

So both the unassigned and the assigned box stay at T+11, 13, 17, 19, 35 and 37 h, whatever the device clock says. That meets the pass rule: a box goes only by an explicit user action.

The window the Then refers to depends on Q6 (Daniela). The code has no window at all, so a 12, 18 or 36 h clearing rule would not happen. This is recorded under half:Q6 window and does not decide the verdict.

One item sits outside the verdict. The hidden Rounding Sheet (Q14, behind `VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET`) shows assigned boxes only when they were placed "today". It works out "today" from the device clock (`new Date()`), so on that screen a wrong device date would hide boxes. The pad does not use this rule.

openQuestions: Q6 window: the code has no retention window for Quick Dictation boxes. Unassigned and assigned boxes stay until the physician deletes them (or deletes the account), so they never clear at 12, 18 or 36 h. If Daniela sets a window, there is no code for it yet.

Q14: if 'stays on the sheet' turns out to mean the Rounding Sheet, assigned boxes there are filtered to 'placed today' by the device clock (roundingSheet.ts isToday). That would conflict with 3.8 (server clock, not device clock).

Q6 (Daniela): the code has no retention window for Quick Dictation boxes, assigned or unassigned. They stay until the physician deletes them (or clears the pad, or deletes the account). If Q6 sets a 12, 18 or 36 h window, nothing in the code would apply it, and the 'clear exactly at the window' half would then fail.

Q14: the Then is read against the pad. The hidden Rounding Sheet filters assigned boxes by a 'today' check on the device clock. If the sheet is turned on, a wrong device date would hide those boxes from it, which goes against 'the same on every device clock'.
